propositions: The outbound differ compares in vendor shape (Jira-specific keys like accountId, parent.key) while the inbound differ compares in canonical shape, creating an asymmetry that violates ADR 0035 §(d) canonical-comparison principle.

The outbound update path must canonicalize the snapshot entry via InboundMapper.map_remote_to_local before field comparison, then emit vendor payload only via a new OutboundMapper.map_fields_to_remote method at the emission boundary.

InboundMapper output must be widened with three new canonical keys (assignee_identity, remote_parent_id, reporter_identity) that contain backend-agnostic identity information, replacing vendor-shape-tolerant helpers like _assignee_matches and _extract_jira_field.

The arbitration baseline remains vendor-shaped at rest (no migration) but must be canonicalized at read time by applying map_remote_to_local to partial _BASELINE_FIELDS subsets, with absent vendor keys mapping to absent canonical keys (never defaulted).

The new neutral field-comparison helpers in core must preserve decision-for-decision equivalence with the old vendor-shape comparison for all status/priority/assignee/parent/description/label changes, including accountId fast-path and unmappable-remote-status behavior.
Core imports of adapters.jira must be eliminated from outbound_differ.py and vendor snapshot key literals must not appear there, verified by AST denylist enforcing the canonical-comparison boundary.
